title: PSG5-LIMIT: sharper first-feasible height and pure resource envelopes

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE PSG5-LIMIT algorithm and exact inherited parameter rule in proof.md recover all of s from independent ideal source copies with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3. On EVERY branch, including rejected suppliers, discarded copies, all retries, failures and either cutoff, its total charged sequential work T is O(2^((49/100)(n log2 n)^(2/3))). This is its full uniform bit-length envelope for n>=2; the explicit finite branch covers smaller n. Its exact envelope growth index is 2/3. All outside constants are absolute, independent of N,s and outcomes. This holds jointly with the other three resources and the zero-tolerance ideal-copy guarantee for the same algorithm/configuration.

For every N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE PSG5-LIMIT algorithm and exact inherited parameter rule in proof.md recover all of s from independent ideal source copies with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3. On EVERY branch, including rejected suppliers, discarded copies, all retries, failures and either cutoff, its peak classical bits S_C is O(n^2). This is its full uniform bit-length envelope for n>=2; the explicit finite branch covers smaller n. Its exact envelope growth index is 0/1. All outside constants are absolute, independent of N,s and outcomes. This holds jointly with the other three resources and the zero-tolerance ideal-copy guarantee for the same algorithm/configuration.

For every N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE PSG5-LIMIT algorithm and exact inherited parameter rule in proof.md recover all of s from independent ideal source copies with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3. On EVERY branch, including rejected suppliers, discarded copies, all retries, failures and either cutoff, its peak qubits S_Q is O(n). This is its full uniform bit-length envelope for n>=2; the explicit finite branch covers smaller n. Its exact envelope growth index is 0/1. All outside constants are absolute, independent of N,s and outcomes. This holds jointly with the other three resources and the zero-tolerance ideal-copy guarantee for the same algorithm/configuration.

For every N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, with n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE PSG5-LIMIT algorithm and exact inherited parameter rule in proof.md recover all of s from independent ideal source copies with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3. On EVERY branch, including rejected suppliers, discarded copies, all retries, failures and either cutoff, its total acquired source copies Q including failures and discards is O(2^((7/10)(n log2 n)^(1/3))). This is its full uniform bit-length envelope for n>=2; the explicit finite branch covers smaller n. Its exact envelope growth index is 1/3. All outside constants are absolute, independent of N,s and outcomes. This holds jointly with the other three resources and the zero-tolerance ideal-copy guarantee for the same algorithm/configuration.

For the same PSG5-LIMIT algorithm and complete parameter rule in proof.md, the proved malformed-sample fractional guarantee is epsilon(n)=0: all Q acquired source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N>=2 and every s, unconditional full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3 jointly with all four every-branch resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted, and this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
